text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Aw, GGs, Trainer… Well, these machines aren't supposed to be easy to win from.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Hey, it is what it is. It'd be no fun if you always got something, yeah?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: 'Sides, the best part of playing these machines is the rush when the claw comes up! Enjoying that part's the key to these games!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Don't beat yourself up! C'mon, I'll treat you something sweet!
